title: New Lead to Complete Deal Card Production Vertical Slice

workstreams.name: Governed research skills and bounded recovery
workstreams.operatorOutcome: LandPortal, government/zoning, public-records, and comp research use explicit completion rules; deterministic misses invoke bounded recovery only when justified and recovered evidence enters the canonical evidence path.
workstreams.requiredDataState: An established canonical subject with deterministic provider outcomes and a controlled unsupported public-record platform fixture.

steps: Open a Deal Card with an established subject
Run or reuse the relevant property research
Confirm required output rather than invocation count controls completion
Confirm any justified recovery and exact unresolved status are operator-readable
Hard refresh and confirm retained evidence and status do not rerun research

failureConditions: A deterministic miss is presented as exhausted while a valid recovery route remains
A recovery result exists only in model prose
An unusable comp row satisfies valuation readiness
A cancelled or superseded run admits late evidence

requirements.text: Four governed LandOS-native research skills encode domain procedure, fallback, evidence, completion criteria, and validation scenarios.
LandPortal and government/zoning deterministic misses select bounded recovery without creating duplicate standing agents.
Public Records deterministic retrieval hands off to one governed specialist only after deterministic exhaustion and returns a structured result.
Recovered evidence enters canonical evidence admission with run identity and late-write rejection.
Comp completion requires usable validated comps, not merely returned records.

workstreams.name: Prerequisite scheduling, F3 closure, and readiness reconciliation
workstreams.operatorOutcome: Independent county, ZIP, seller, and parcel lanes start as soon as their own prerequisites exist; every direct Deal Card launch surface consumes Canonical Subject State and declared capability prerequisites.
inScope: county Market Research and Market Pulse
workstreams.requiredDataState: A county-known and ZIP-known lead without an established parcel, contrasted with an established-subject Deal Card.

steps: Confirm county and ZIP market work is eligible while parcel lanes wait
Confirm parcel panel controls cannot bypass declared prerequisites
Establish the subject through a viable route
Confirm readiness re-plans and satisfied items do not churn
Hard refresh and confirm no research reruns

failureConditions: A direct panel launches parcel work while the parcel prerequisite is unmet
County or ZIP market work waits unnecessarily on parcel identity
Canonical Subject State says resolved while a Deal Card consumer says no parcel
Satisfied readiness items rerun without new evidence

requirements.text: Direct per-panel capability endpoints use Canonical Subject State and the declared prerequisite evaluator, closing F3.
County Market Research and Market Pulse can run or reuse when county is known without official parcel verification.
ZIP Market Research can run or reuse when ZIP is known.
Parcel-specific lanes wait for and then consume the established working subject.
New evidence re-plans readiness while already satisfied items are reused rather than churned.

workstreams.name: Fresh New Lead to completed Deal Card production journey
workstreams.operatorOutcome: Tyler can enter a usable lead, leave it alone, and return to the most complete honest Deal Card LandOS can produce without developer intervention.
inScope: Property, Market, Seller, and Deal Intelligence
workstreams.requiredDataState: Two fresh disposable leads: one with full address, APN, and seller basics; one with one incomplete or non-authoritative identifier plus another viable property pointer.

steps: Observe autonomous subject establishment and prerequisite-driven research
Open the researched Deal Card and inspect all intelligence surfaces
Hard refresh and confirm persistence and no unintended reruns
Confirm the viable route establishes the subject despite the imperfect pointer
Confirm final known, interpreted, assumed, partial, blocked, and unresolved distinctions

testRequirements: full focused regression suite from the brief
real browser acceptance for both fresh leads
failureConditions: A fresh lead requires developer intervention
A viable subject route is ignored because another pointer is imperfect
Intelligence is stale relative to admitted evidence
Refresh mutates state or reruns expensive research
Operator output hides incomplete or blocked requirements

requirements.text: A fresh conventional intake reaches a researched current Deal Card through autonomous subject resolution and independent prerequisite scheduling.
A fresh alternate-resolution intake uses the viable property pointer instead of failing because another pointer is incomplete or non-authoritative.
Property, Market, Seller, and Deal Intelligence consume reconciled evidence and remain current.
Refresh and restart preserve state without rerunning research, and cancelled or superseded work cannot write late.
The final Deal Card accurately distinguishes known, interpreted, assumed, partial, blocked, unresolved, and genuine operator-action states.
